gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.

gaps.explanation: 'The wind strengthened' — the verb from STRONG.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.
'Cause drowsiness' — the quality noun from drowsy.

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.

gaps.explanation: 'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.
